kolbrun.desc: Envoy Kolbrun Hailstride (3x): slate wool tunic, belted grey trousers, white fur mantle, braided hair, Kolbrun's horn on a strap.

jarl.desc: Jarl Thyra Stonebrow (3.2x): rust tunic, belted trousers, bear-fur mantle, rune-iron circlet, long grey braids.

ulfar_town.desc: Ulfar Mossback in town (3x): moss-green tunic, patched belted trousers, moss on his shoulders, shy and gentle.

rimewife.desc: Rimewife Solvi (2.8x): blue-grey wrap tunic, belted skirt over leggings, rune-glow braids, rune staff.

skuli.desc: Skuli (2x, a giant kid): oversized rust tunic, rope-belted trousers, a goatherd's crook.

goatwife.desc: Brynja Hornwise (3x): leather apron over a tunic and belted trousers, rolled sleeves, hair in a bun.

grimsa.desc: Grimsa the trader (3x): layered wool tunics, a wide belt hung with pouches, a fur cap-less braid.

rimecaptain.desc: Rime-Captain Hjordis Icejaw (3x): leather jerkin over a belted tunic, belted trousers, round shield on her back, spear. No plate.

gi_man.desc: Stonehollow giant villager (3x): wool tunic, belted trousers, bushy braided beard.

gi_woman.desc: Stonehollow giant villager (2.9x): moss tunic, belted trousers, fur mantle, long hair.
